title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・連星の宴

text_block_list.name: Ayabe and Opera O
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant, pant…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Exhale… Ahhh! Yes, that was incredible!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Encore! Encore! Our performance must continue!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Taking down veterans and newcomers alike! This quartet is top of the line!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Do whatever you want. Just leave me out of it.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes. I will indeed do what I want.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Your voice is piercing, yet it overlaps with our own…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And certainly, together, it will travel, resonating unfiltered, into the ears of those eager to hear of our exploits.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Whatever you say.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah… Then, Ayabe, you understand where our next performance will be held, no?

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: A stage where only the strongest Umamusume in the world gather. The—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I told you. I don't care about your theatrics.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh… Err, Ayabe left…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hehe… Yes, Doto. But her leaving was not a rejection.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: It was a sign that she already knows.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Next… can we do the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It's a part of the Senior Autumn Triple Crown. I think I'm fit for the distance too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: And… I'm not suggesting this because of what just happened.
choice_data_list: Hm? …All right, let's go for the Japan Cup!
Hm? …All right, let's go for the Japan Cup!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to train when you are.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so, we set our sights on the Japan Cup, which will be held in a month.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We'll have to do a lot of intensive training in a short period of time. I want her to run with the same excitement she had today, if not more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time to redouble my efforts as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff… Ergh…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: They're so fast. And so strong…
